checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Four separate square slides with exact names in order
must.why: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily in order, square; names are in all caps.
Split monstera leaves, upright striped snake plant, trailing pothos vines, peace lily with small white spathes (modest but present).
All use sage on cream with consistent flat print look; peace lily is a bit more detailed.
Identical double border, serif lettering, paper grain and pot with terracotta rim.

must.item: Only plant and name change; layout aligned and readable
must.why: Pot and text baseline aligned; names legible.

faults.what: Names are rendered in all caps rather than as written; the user said 'carved capital lettering', so this is acceptable.
Peace lily spathes are small and not strongly white; the leaves have more detailed white veining than the other plants.
A terracotta pot rim adds a third colour beyond sage and cream, but it is consistent across slides.
Style looks more like a clean vector print than a rough linocut.

summary: Four consistent, well-aligned sage-and-cream slides with correct names and distinct plants; the only weaknesses are a small, faint peace lily spathe and a polished rather than rough linocut feel.
